Bash(bash -c '
# Direct keychain lookup
DIRECT_TOKEN=$\(security find-generic-password -a ""toby.balsley@gmail.com"" -s ""jira-api-token"" -w 2>/dev/null\)
echo ""Direct token length: ${#DIRECT_TOKEN}""

# Through script
source ./.ybotbot/jira-tools/jira-config.sh
echo ""Script token length: ${#JIRA_API_TOKEN}""

# Compare
if [ ""$DIRECT_TOKEN"" = ""$JIRA_API_TOKEN"" ]; then
    echo ""MATCH""
else
    echo ""MISMATCH""
    echo ""Direct hex \(last 20\):"" 
    echo -n ""${DIRECT_TOKEN: -20}"" | xxd | tail -1
    echo ""Script hex \(last 20\):""
    echo -n ""${JIRA_API_TOKEN: -20}"" | xxd | tail -1
fi

# Test direct
echo """"
echo ""Test with direct token:""
curl -s -w ""HTTP: %{http_code}\\n"" -u ""toby.balsley@gmail.com:$DIRECT_TOKEN"" -H ""Accept: application/json"" ""https://hdtsllc.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/myself"" | tail -1

echo ""Test with script token:""
curl -s -w ""HTTP: %{http_code}\\n"" -u ""toby.balsley@gmail.com:$JIRA_API_TOKEN"" -H ""Accept: application/json"" ""https://hdtsllc.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/myself"" | tail -1
')

cat /tmp/jira_projects.json | head -c 1000
')
